column.name: ccategory
column.title: Contact Category
column.where: deleted is not true and donotshow is not true

column.name: ccFromFileDate
column.title: SSM Account Info\CC Form File Date

column.name: swdTpsIngCreditLine
column.title: Manufacturer's Account Info\SWD - TPS - ING\Credit Line

column.name: swdTpsIngAgencyRepNumber
column.title: Manufacturer's Account Info\SWD - TPS - ING\Agency Rep Number

sqlquery.from:
( select distinct cc.id, cc.firstname,cc.lastname, cc.primaryemail, cm.name campaignname, cc.ccategory,
address.address_line, address.address_city, address.address_zipcode, address.country,
(CASE cc.contacttype WHEN 1 THEN 'CRM Contact' WHEN 2 THEN 'Client' WHEN 3 THEN 'Supplier' WHEN 4 THEN 'Employee' END) as contacttype ,ca.name accountname ,category_id
, cccf.date_value1 mapFileDate , cccf.date_value2 ccFromFileDate , cccf.string_value3 preferredMethodOfCommunication , cccf.string_value10 miscelaneous , cccf.double_value6 swdTpsIngCreditLine , cccf.double_value7 numberOfLocations , cccf.string_value7 swdTpsIngAgencyRepNumber , cccf.double_value1 rdTourCreditLine , cccf.string_value8 oakleyAccountNumber , cccf.double_value9 ssmAccountInfoCreditLine , cccf.string_value6 accountNumberRdTour
, cacf.double_value6 accountNumberSherWood , cacf.string_value2 customerTrackingRelationshipType , cacf.string_value1 ssmAccountInfoResaleNumber , cacf.string_value5 customerTrackingProductSpecialty , cacf.string_value4 customerTrackingDealerLocationType , cacf.string_value9 customerTrackingDealerBuyingGroupAffiliation , cacf.string_value7 customerTrackingTerritory , cacf.string_value8 customerTrackingOverallCustomerStatus
from (select cc.id, max(cc.customFields_id) customFields_id, array_to_string(array_agg(cc_cg.name),'; ') ccategory ,array_to_string(array_agg(cc_cg.id),',') category_id
, max(cc.crmaccount) crmaccount, max(cc.owner) "owner", max(cc.campaign) campaign , max(cc.firstname) firstname, max(cc.lastname) lastname , max(cc.primaryemail) primaryemail, max(cc.contacttype) contacttype
from "$".crmcontact cc left join "$".crmcontact_contactcategory crm_cc_cg on cc.id=crm_cc_cg.crmcontact_id left join (select id,name,"$".getsubcategory(id) child_id from "$".contactcategory where deleted is not true and donotshow is not true) cc_cg on crm_cc_cg.categories_id=cc_cg.child_id
where cc.deleted is not true and cc.contacttype != 5 group by cc.id ) cc
left outer join "$".crmaccount ca on cc.crmaccount=ca.id left outer join "$".campaign cm on cc.campaign=cm.id
left outer join (select contactid, coalesce(address,'')||' '||coalesce(addressb,'') address_line, zipCode address_zipcode, city address_city, cn.name country from "$".address add left outer join "public".country cn on add.countryid=cn.id where entitytype='contact' and relationtype=1 ) address on cc.id=address.contactid
left join "$".crmcustomfields cccf on cc.customFields_id=cccf.id left join "$".crmcustomfields cacf on ca.customFields_id=cacf.id
inner join ( select distinct crmcontact_id from "$".crmcontact_contactcategory where categories_id in ( select distinct category.id from "$".contactcategoryrbac ccrbac inner join "$".contactcategory category on ccrbac.contactCategory_id=category.id where ( category.doNotShow is null or category.doNotShow is not true ) or ccrbac.userid=2 or category.owner_id=2 or ( ccrbac.groupid is not null and ccrbac.groupid in ( select distinct edsgroup6_.id from "$".trusteegroup edsgroup6_ inner join "$".trusteegroup_trustee members7_ on edsgroup6_.id=members7_.trusteegroup_id inner join "$".trustee edstrustee8_ on members7_.members_id=edstrustee8_.id inner join (select distinct edstrustee9_.id from "$".trustee edstrustee9_ where edstrustee9_.trusteeID=2 and edstrustee9_.trusteetype=2) abs on edstrustee8_.id=abs.id
) ) ) ) as "contactids" on cc.id = "contactids".crmcontact_id
) t
